name: Simon (called Niger)
title: Prophet and teacher in Antioch
summary: Simon, called Niger, was one of the prophets and teachers in the church at Antioch. Together with the other leaders, they fasted and prayed when the Holy Spirit called Barnabas and Saul for missionary service.

keyEvents.title: Among the leaders in Antioch
keyEvents.description: Simon Niger was among the prophets and teachers who sent out Barnabas and Saul after the Spirit's call.
